Let's start with the hiring manager's perspective.

transcript.text: Thank you all for these important disclosures. Let me summarize what I've heard and outline how I plan to proceed. First, Rina has a disclosed close personal relationship with Jonah and has been coaching him — that's a clear conflict of interest, so Rina will not be appointed to the panel. Second, Elliot has four firsthand observations of Mara's leadership that aren't yet in the formal evidence record — I'll ask Priya to ensure those are documented before any panel evaluation begins, and since Elliot holds material evidence, I need to consider whether his inclusion on the panel is appropriate or creates an evidence-handling concern. Third, Sofia has confirmed we need standardized questions and individual written score sheets — that will be incorporated into the selection packet. Fourth, Tariq has raised Mara's accessibility need for 48-hour advance questions and written responses — per our accessibility practice, that will be implemented, and we'll ensure both candidates have equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the criteria. Before I finalize the panel composition, I'd like to hear from the remaining round-robin participants — have the peer manager and HR representative had a chance to review these considerations, and are there any additional process or relationship considerations to add?
